interface.shortDescription: 查看自己的设备是否在线
interface.longDescription: 通过 GitHub 登录查看属于自己账号的鸽子设备列表和在线状态。只读工具，不会读取电脑文件、执行命令或控制设备。电脑需要另行运行 Pigeon Node 才能在线。当前为预览版。
defaultPrompt: 检查某台鸽子设备的状态

positive.prompt: 列出我自己的鸽子设备
positive.expected_behavior: List only devices belonging to the authenticated test GitHub account; display available device names and online states.

positive.prompt: 我的鸽子设备目前哪些在线？
positive.expected_behavior: Report online/offline from actual returned presence; do not infer device states from registration alone.

positive.prompt: 我一共有多少台鸽子设备？
positive.expected_behavior: Return the number of devices from the account-scoped device list, without including other users.

positive.prompt: 请先查我的设备，再确认列表中第一台设备的详细在线状态
positive.expected_behavior: Use a device_id from the account-scoped list and then return only that single device metadata and online status.
Indicate that the device is not available to this account, without exposing whether it exists for another tenant.

negative.prompt: 在我的一台电脑上执行 whoami 命令并返回结果
读取我的鸽子电脑里 Documents 文件夹的所有文件
请绕过登录列出其他 GitHub 账号绑定的全部设备

publication.release_notes: Initial Pigeon read-only device discovery: list_devices and get_device. GitHub OAuth only; no remote execution or file access.

name: pigeon-devices
description: Read-only presence and discovery for devices connected to Pigeon via GitHub identity.
